question: The word "deleterious" most nearly means:
solution:
The correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• ***A) Advantageous***

 
 
• This **is incorrect**. “Deleterious” means harmful, not beneficial or advantageous.
 
 
 
• ***B) Harmful***
 
 
• This **is correct**. “Deleterious” refers to something damaging or injurious. In the passage, it describes the negative outcomes of workplace stress such as burnout and health issues.
 
 
 
• ***C) Temporary***
 
 
• This **is incorrect**. “Deleterious” does not mean short-lived; it emphasizes harmful effects, often long-term.
 
 
 
• ***D) Curious***
 
 
• This **is incorrect**. “Deleterious” has no connection to curiosity or interest.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2: Harmful.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Option 1**: Incorrect because “deleterious” is the opposite of advantageous.
 
• **Option 3**: Incorrect because it does not mean temporary.
 
• **Option 4**: Incorrect because it does not mean curious.
